title: VDB2 Better Advancements
description: Better Advancetements its a minecraft mod\plugin with a lot of new minecraft advancements!
body:
Better Advancements is a datapack that expands Minecraft's vanilla achievement system, adding new challenges and goals to make your journey even more fun and rewarding.

Inspired by the original style of the game, the datapack brings new achievements consistent with vanilla gameplay, without modifying the main experience, only enriching it.
From simple tasks to more complex feats, you'll always have a new reason to explore, mine, build, and survive in the world of Minecraft.

✨ Key features:

New achievements fully integrated into the vanilla system.

Balanced progression, maintaining the original essence of the game.

Incentive to explore different aspects of gameplay.

Compatible with other survival experiences.

Perfect for those who want more challenges and rewards without losing the classic spirit of Minecraft!

**Official VDB2 Creators Project**
